key_insight: Across three decades, crystal structure prediction has expanded from global search to learned generation, but no approach consistently dominates.
engineering_relevance: Reliable materials discovery requires evaluating candidate generation separately from structural relaxation, ranking, and physical qualification.
method: Survey CSP methods, software, reviews, and benchmarks from 1996 to October 2026.
Classify approaches by candidate construction and exploration, from template search to deep generative models.
Compare benchmark recovery and audit experimentally examined predictions.
evidence_signal: A 46-target leaderboard favors a template method on top-1 recovery without significant paired differences from several generative competitors; among 68 experimentally examined materials, 52 had confirmed structures and 23 predictions preceded experiment.
watch_item: Within the reviewed evidence, no independently confirmed discovery involved a deep generative model predicting the structure before experiment.
paper_title: Crystal Structure Prediction from Search to Learning: A 30-Year Expedition
